notes.title: MAP EDITOR is here!
notes.content:
[h1]LIGHTNING Editor[/h1]
Scratching one more off the road map!
Whether you want to re-create an environment or create a new one, the LIGHTNING Editor is calling upon you, with the capability to import your own models, The possibilities are now endless.

[h1]Share your creation[/h1]
Easily, publish your maps straight from the LIGHTNING Editor and play in it right away with other players!

[h1]Import Your Own Models[/h1]
The most wanted and anticipated feature for any level editors, LIGHTNING Editor has it.
Do you prefer to just make the map in the 3D modeling of your own choice and then importing it in? 
Done.
Do you want to import the 3D models you have and use those?
Done.

[h1]Designers Invitation[/h1]
Pour your love into the creation and see it making its way into the official map pool with your name on it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43109337/784758b2c8283f270da5960c1c844e7a543b2b5a.jpg[/img]

LIGHTNING Editor is designed to be the most approachable map editor for the FPS genre.
[list]
[*] No cluttered interface with hidden buttons
[*] No prior 3D modeling experience needed
[*] No need to install third-party or separate software to make maps for the game.
[/list]

In LIGHTNING Editor, everything there is, is all laid out on the screen with not extra buttons to click.
Here is a guide for LIGHTNING Editor to get you started:
https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3009191768

[previewyoutube=gFfqU5cd3a4;full][/previewyoutube]

Stay tuned for more intel.

notes.title: Procedurally Generated Maps
notes.content:
[h2]NEW MAP[/h2]
Introducing the new Procedurally Generated map "Cloud",
Meaning it's different every time you play.

[previewyoutube=7e6NvGU1Ph0;full][/previewyoutube]

Being an Esport FPS, The different thing about this new map is that the common locations such as the Bomb sites and Spawns are static Instead of being procedural. So they're memorable and having no blind spots for defending and re-takes.

"Cloud" is available for all modes except the Horde mode.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43109337/bf871869ef8dbda4aa819919ce228bb832a1bee9.gif[/img]

[h2]NEW TRAINING ENVIRONMENT[/h2]
Training map now has a dynamic kill house course, using procedural tech to fully generate the layout, meaning it's different every time you enter the training environment.
This enables practicing clearing corners without the predictable layout.

This environment is a new addition to the "Training Ground" map.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43109337/8db4692f7c9d75f9ce6930075f01f5cbccc132b9.gif[/img]

Stay tuned for more intel.

notes.title: NEW FEATURES ADDED: New Aiming System and Detailed Combat Report
notes.content:
[h2]1.NEW AIMING SYSTEM[/h2]
The first new feature is the C.A.R Aiming system, known as Point Aiming in LIGHTNING.
Pushing more into the tactical gameplay.

Checkout the demonstration:

[previewyoutube=F5_7ywb5lNs;full][/previewyoutube]


[b][i]How this new aiming system works?[/i][/b]

More accurate than hip-fire, best for accurate first few shots.
This aiming system pulls the gun to the center in a way that you are looking over the barrel.

[b][i]How is it different from hip firing?[/i]
[/b]
Point Aiming is more accurate even at distance. but cannot make the hip-firing obsolete.

[b]POINT AIMING[/b]

Pro:
[list]
[*] Very accurate for the first few shots.
[*] No Zooming, maintains your perspective.
[*] Better view of your perspective.
[/list]

Cons:
[list]
[*] Loses accuracy fast after a few shots.
[*] Reduced walk speed.
[*] No leaning to sides.
[/list]

[b]HIP-FIRE[/b]

Pro:
[list]
[*] Can maintain the recoil for long rapid firing.
[*] No effects on walk speed.
[*] No limits to leaning.
[/list]

Cons:
[list]
[*] First few shots aren't as accurate.
[*] Could Potentially block viewing a portion of the right side.
[/list]


By pulling the gun to the center you'll have a clear perspective to both side of the screen, LIGHTNING being a competitive shooter, this is specially beneficial in a competitive environment where you need as much info of your surrounding as possible.

A viable stance if you don't want to ADS but want to have good accuracy, making it very superior in certain situations and also a tactical choice.

[h2]2.DETAILED COMBAT REPORT[/h2]
Second Feature in this update is a detailed Combat Report

In round-based modes, upon losing a gun fight and entering the spectator mode you will see a detailed report with an all new simulation of when each part of the body got hit in order.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43109337/6e67ddd54dd98891a77c6ca37996fdb2702a5a86.gif[/img]
You can see that each damage node gives a total damage done to that part along with hit order and showing damage for each individual hits.



This Update is one of the many similar updates to come in order to ultimately make LIGHTNING the better FPS and Esport experience.

And that sums up the new update,
Stay tuned for more intel.

notes.title: Introducing Economy Mode
notes.content:
Hello and Greetings!

Introducing the main competitive mode,
A well-known match for the competitive scene.


[h2]What is Economy mode?[/h2]
Round-based 5v5, with a focus on tactical play and currency management.
weapons and their attachments plus utilities will be bought at the start of each round with match-earned prestige.

[previewyoutube=keJUmbpE1oc;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]BASIC DETAILS[/h2]

Any bought Attachments will be available team-wide and also throughout the match until the second half where the team switch happens and everything gets a reset.

Attachment accessibility is this way so the actual gun has more weight in deciding a gunfight, meaning attachments will play a lesser role here due to how widely and fast they will become accessible to the team.

On the other hand, firearms along with owned utilities will be dropped upon death and will be accessible to anyone else for picking up.

Character abilities however limited, are also a deciding factor in each round.


The Economy UI comes with extensive weapons and attachments stat display,
Stay tuned for more in depth explanation.
